notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Spies! [/h1]

[b]We are happy to announce that SpyHack is coming to Steam on 4th of December![/b] Get ready to become a secret agent of the Advanced Technology Division and protect humanity from self-destruction! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/b87d1f555da8647161954d197dd2ac50a664b9c6.png[/img]

Remember that you can already play the full version of this game on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/spyhack-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]!

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/spyhack-switch/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32210824/2f315b41b3f917d984c518d23180ef1ee5b2c3a8.png[/img][/url]

Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/dkwz4H3pgH]Discord server[/url], where you can talk about the game and post your suggestions!
